title: XDRIP on Samsung Smartwatch
body:
is it possible to scan my Freestyle Libre sensor with a Samsung smartwatch as standalone solution?
I wont just hold my watch to the sensor. without any bluetooth collector.

comments.body:
No, not possible.
Samsung watches run tizen os and there are only android applications available.

Ok thanks
When speak from Android, do you mean Wear OS as standalone solution?

Yes! So far there are no applications for tizen os, and  - here I've to correct myself - there are also no applications for wear os (android watches) you can nfc-scan your libre sensor with.
xdrip runs on wear os, but relies on a bridge device like blukon or miaomiao which read the sensor via nfc and send the data using bluetooth to the android (wear os) watch (or the phone).
